req.title: DELETE rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 on DELETE for a non-existent playerId.

doc.reasoning: Two violations were reported: test[0] has kind=negative but heuristic=EP (EP must only be used with positive kind), and test[4] has kind=negative but heuristic=STC (STC must only be used with positive kind). Fix: change test[0] heuristic from EP to NEG (it is a negative test exercising the error partition), and change test[4] heuristic from STC to NEG (it is a negative state-based test confirming 404 after deletion). All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_player_returns_404
preconditions: Squad number 9999 does not exist in the database
trace: R-PLAYER-015: system shall respond with HTTP 404 on DELETE for a non-existent playerId
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/9999')
assert r.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_does_not_return_404
preconditions: Database contains squad number 10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
expected: Player with squad number 10 is removed
trace: R-PLAYER-015: 404 must only fire for non-existent players; existing player must yield 204
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert r.status_code == 204
assert r.status_code != 404

tests.name: test_delete_twice_second_call_returns_404
actions: Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/5 (second call — player no longer exists)
trace: R-PLAYER-015: after a successful delete the player is gone; a repeat DELETE must return 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert r1.status_code == 204
r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert r2.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_player_response_body_and_status
preconditions: Database contains squad numbers 1-26; squad number 99999 does not exist
actions: Inspect status code and confirm it is exactly 404 (not 400, not 422, not 500)
trace: R-PLAYER-015: error pathway must be exactly 404, ruling out other error codes
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/99999')
assert r.status_code == 404
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 204
assert r.status_code != 400
assert r.status_code != 422
assert r.status_code != 500

tests.name: test_delete_squad_number_26_exists_then_27_does_not
preconditions: Database contains squad number 26 (Aditya Mehta); squad number 27 does not exist
trace: R-PLAYER-015: BVA at max seeded boundary (26 exists, 27 does not); catches off-by-one mutations in existence check
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

r_exists = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/26')
assert r_exists.status_code == 204
r_missing = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/27')
assert r_missing.status_code == 404
